precision: float16, sdpa; T4 does not require bfloat16 or FlashAttention
limits: Schema validity and model consistency are not visual-label accuracy. All predictions are unverified weak descriptions; unknown is not negative. Small biased catalog/wearing pilot, limited resolution, no confidence calibration or human agreement claim.
decision: Do not scale or train on these appearance descriptions
rationale: Original schema pass did not establish useful wash supervision. Two responses violated the specified back/side front-detail mask; three none-fading outputs asserted explicitly faded hip whiskers. All initially accepted responses avoided unknown and largely repeated local-detail labels. No independent attribute accuracy labels exist.
visual_review_scope: Codex comparison against the six previously displayed audit assets and the three existing Commons crops; no human attribute-accuracy labels. Coarse color may be useful for proposals but was not validated as training truth.
validator_caveat: Back/side masking is a prompt-contract consistency check, not visual ground truth. An oblique front view may reveal front details even when a model tags it side; that can be a view-label/schema issue. Thigh/knee lightening alone is allowed with no fading because illumination may cause it.
